limitations: NO-GO template: model, provider CLI, requested effort and active local budget are unverified and unset; a separately reviewed plan must declare each family slot and one shared active_budget_seconds integer from 1 to 5400 before a pilot run.

A configured plan binds requested local CLI/model/effort and one local active wall-time limit across N, S and T. It does not authorize provider calls or prove effective settings, provider identity, provider-side caps, cost, tool parity or criterion 4.
